newsitem.title: UK: Guinness watches LVMH with interest.
newsitem.headline: Guinness watches LVMH with interest.

text.p: British drinks giant Guinness Plc said on Friday it was watching LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton "with interest" amid speculation the French luxury goods group will further raise its stake in Grand Metropolitan.

But Guinness, which plans to press ahead with its 23.8 billion stg merger with GrandMet despite LVMH's objections, declined to comment on whether it was lobbying for the support of institutional shareholders.
"This is a matter for GrandMet and (LVMH's chairman) Mr Arnault," said a Guinness spokesman.

"As far as we're concerned in Guinness, we are pressing on with the merger. The two regulatory bodies are due to announce today. We are confident it (the merger) will go through at the end of the year and we're watching the developments with interest," he added.
